title: Step-by-Step Guide to Custom User Controls in Business Central
summary: Custom user controls in Business Central use HTML, JavaScript, and AL to create bespoke UI components beyond standard controls. The post demonstrates building a star rating control for vendors, covering the control addin definition, JavaScript implementation, and AL page integration.
key_points: User controls bridge AL and JavaScript to extend Business Central's UI capabilities with custom HTML and CSS components
Control addins declare events and procedures that enable bidirectional communication between JavaScript and AL code
The startup script initializes the control and signals readiness via OnControlReady event before AL can interact with it
Data flows from AL to JavaScript through procedures like SetRating, and from JavaScript to AL through events like OnRatingChanged
Proper state management with flags prevents recursion when updating controls from both AL and user interactions

quotes.text: User controls are the way that users interact with the system.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that controls are the fundamental mechanism for user interaction in Business Central

quotes.text: These are small HTML and JavaScript components we can create to add user interfaces to Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that custom user controls are web-based components integrated into BC for enhanced UX

quotes.text: You can create entire bespoke interface systems to meet specific data entry needs.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the broader potential of user controls beyond simple examples
